construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

input.synthetic: Required literal true; all fixture entities are fictitious
input.catalog: JSON feed array, 0..1000 products: unique sku, name, description, category, tags[str], price decimal string, currency uppercase three-letter code, stock nonnegative integer
input.basket: Array of unique {sku,quantity}; known SKU and quantity from 1 through catalog stock
input.clickstream: JSON event-log array, 0..10000 {customer_id,sku,event}; same shopper, known SKU, event view/click/add_to_basket
input.search: query nonblank text up to 500 characters with ASCII searchable tokens; optional limit 1..100 default 10, personalize default false, include_out_of_stock default false

output.success: status ok, synthetic true, query, personalized, ranking, total_matches before limit, results[{sku,name,price,currency,stock,score,matched_terms}], basket[{sku,quantity,unit_price,currency,stock,line_total}]
output.failure: status error and message; CLI exits 2 for validation, decoding, file or usage errors

shared_schema.validation: Single validate() boundary checks all input entities before indexing or invoking embeddings. Unknown fields, duplicate SKUs/JSON keys, invalid references, nonfinite JSON numbers and unsupported review/endorsement fields rejected. The optional embedding result has its own contract validation.
shared_schema.embedding_interface: search_products(data, embedder=None): injected Python callable receives [query, product_text...] in SKU order, returns equal-dimensional finite nonzero numeric vectors. Cosine similarity clamped to [0,1]. Callable failures or invalid vectors raise ValidationError. Never enabled via CLI or connected to a live provider.

cross_stage_handoffs: One functionality only: shared validated input -> canonical-token weighted inverted index -> lexical and optional embedding scores -> consent-gated personalization -> catalog-grounded results and basket projection

behavior.ranking: Bounded English synonym canonicalization plus weighted field overlap and smoothed inverse document frequency; optional 2*cosine embedding contribution. No query match or positive embedding similarity means no result. Stable rounded-score descending and SKU ascending tie break.
behavior.personalization: Explicit opt-in plus both GDPR and CCPA consent required; preference/category overlap and capped clickstream SKU bonuses only after eligibility. Profile, basket and events cannot influence ranking when personalization is false.
behavior.catalog_fidelity: Prices, currency and stock copied directly from validated feed, never generated. Basket totals use decimal arithmetic; no cross-currency aggregate.
behavior.endorsements: No reviews, ratings or endorsements generated or accepted as structured product fields. Descriptions are used only for retrieval, not returned as reviews. Arbitrary text is not semantically certified.
behavior.synthetic_fixture: Invented Fable and Cloudlet shoe SKUs, imaginary backpack, synthetic shopper Ada, synthetic click event and basket. No real personal data.
behavior.constraints: Demonstrative validation rules only; not GDPR/CCPA compliance certification.

excluded: Review generation or factual endorsement verification

test_outcomes.cli: Example executed successfully; one JSON object with status ok, one matching product, catalog-grounded basket total 77.00; exit 0
